overview_description: List, create, read, update and delete the accounting codes that carry general ledger account numbers and names.
intro: An accounting code is a settings record that carries a general ledger account number and name and a code type such as `sales_revenue`. You can list, create, read, update and delete accounting codes. This area has 5 endpoints, and all seven SDKs call every one.
notes: **Requests and responses wrap the record in `accounting_code`.** A create sends `{"accounting_code": {...}}` and a read returns the record under the same key.
**A create sets the code type with `account_code_type`.** The stored record reports the same value in `default_match_key`, such as `sales_revenue`.
**Discount profiles need a discount accounting code.** A discount profile accepts only an accounting code whose `default_match_key` is `discount`.
**Listings page by cursor.** Pass `limit` for the page size, then pass `pagination.next_cursor` back as `cursor` while `pagination.has_more` is true.
**A delete returns `204` with no body.** Reading the accounting code afterwards returns `404`.

endpoints.title: List accounting codes
endpoints.summary: Returns a page of accounting codes under `data`, with paging details under `pagination`.
endpoints.description: Lists the accounting codes on the instance. Pass `limit` to set the page size, and while `pagination.has_more` is true pass `pagination.next_cursor` back as `cursor` to read the next page. Other fields filter as `filter_<field>` or `filter_<field>_<operator>`, and `sort` orders the results.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many records to return on one page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `pagination.next_cursor` of the previous page, to read the next one.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: The field to sort by. Prefix it with `-` for descending order, such as `-created_on`.

200.description: A page of accounting codes, under `data`.

endpoints.title: Create an accounting code
endpoints.summary: Creates an accounting code and returns it under `accounting_code`.
endpoints.description: Send the new accounting code under `accounting_code`. Give it a `name`, an `account_code_type` such as `sales_revenue` and a `gl_account_number`. The stored code reports its type in `default_match_key` as well.

endpoints.title: Retrieve an accounting code
endpoints.summary: Returns one accounting code by its `id`, under `accounting_code`.
endpoints.description: Reads the accounting code with this `id`. The `id` is the one a listing or a create returns.

parameters.name: accounting_code_id
parameters.description: The accounting code's `id`, as a listing or a create returns it.

endpoints.title: Delete an accounting code
endpoints.summary: Deletes an accounting code. The response has no body.
endpoints.description: Deletes the accounting code with this `id`. Reading the same `id` afterwards returns `404`.

parameters.name: accounting_code_id
parameters.description: The accounting code's `id`, as a listing or a create returns it.

204.description: The accounting code is deleted. The response has no body.

endpoints.title: Update an accounting code
endpoints.summary: Changes the fields you send on an accounting code and returns it under `accounting_code`.
endpoints.description: Send the fields to change under `accounting_code`. The response holds the whole accounting code after the change.

parameters.name: accounting_code_id
parameters.description: The accounting code's `id`, as a listing or a create returns it.

created_by.description: Null in every record read so far, so its type is not known.

description.description: Null in every record read so far, so its type is not known.

last_updated_by.description: Null in every record read so far, so its type is not known.

limit.description: The page size applied to this page.

has_more.description: Whether another page follows. Trust this over `next_cursor`, which can still be set on the last page.

next_cursor.description: Pass this back as `cursor` to read the next page.
